post.description: Records a point of sale transaction as a camera event so the transaction details can be overlaid on recorded footage. Requires write access to the target camera. Footage capture is best-effort: the overlay only appears where the target camera was recording the transaction window (e.g. cameras in detections or adaptive recording modes), and a backdated timestamp may fall outside retained footage. A 200 response confirms the event was recorded, not that video exists for the window.
